"For each active lease, derive raw internal I and external E from its live ICMP: positive self echoes of low targets add the responder to I; any non-timeout low probe answered by a different address adds that responder to E. And "each offer's assignment count is at most its capacity" ✓ (the entry arc OF_group → offer has capacity cap(o) ✓).

Now let me think about the quota semantics once more: "Each assigned request consumes one unit at its group and every ancestor in the request forest."

My model: the request r → RF[group(r)] arc → up to the root → T. The arc RF[n] → RF[parent(n)] has capacity c(n) ✓ → the number of requests with group in subtree(n) ≤ c(n) ✓.

✓ Correct.

And the offer side: "Each assignment also consumes one unit at its offer's group and every ancestor in the offer forest." My model: source → OF[root] → ... → OF[group(o)] → offer o. The arc OF[parent]→OF[child] has capacity d(child) ✓ → the flow through it = the number of assignments with group(o) ∈ subtree(child) ✓ (the flow from the source passes down through the tree to the offer's group ✓).

Hmm, careful: the arc OF[parent] → OF[child] carries the flow destined for the offers in child's subtree ✓ — but only if the flow to those offers goes through that arc ✓ (yes, the tree is a tree ✓).

And the source → OF[root] arc has capacity d(root) ✓ = the total assignments in that tree ✓.

Both pass through the arc entering OF[group] ✓ → the constraint at group counts both ✓ correct (the group's constraint covers its whole subtree ✓).

✓.

cat > /workspace/tmp/test_edge.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

# no services at all
job=base_job(services=[],queries=[10])
out,_=run(job)
check('no services', out['snapshots'][0]['leases']==[] and out['plan']=={'resolved':0,'cost':0,'assignments':[]}, out)

# no leases but services
job=base_job(leases=[],queries=[10,20,30,40])
out,_=run(job)
check('no leases', len(out['snapshots'])==4 and out['manifest']==[], out)

# empty captures list with a request
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],
             requests=[{'id':'r','at':10,'lease':'home','target':'2001:db8:1:1200::1','service':'web','group':'all'}])
out,_=run(job)
check('no capture -> inactive request', out['active_requests']==[{'id':'r','active':False}], out)

# zero capacity quotas everywhere
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],
             request_quotas=[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':0}],
             offer_quotas=[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':0}],
             requests=[{'id':'r','at':10,'lease':'home','target':'2001:db8:1:1200::1','service':'web','group':'g'}])
out,_=run(job)
check('zero quotas accepted', 'error' not in out, out)

# quota node with a null parent and a child
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10],
             request_quotas=[{'id':'root','parent':None,'capacity':5},{'id':'leaf','parent':'root','capacity':1}],
             offer_quotas=[{'id':'root','parent':None,'capacity':5}])
out,_=run(job)
check('quota forest accepted', 'error' not in out, out)

# cyclic quota is invalid
job=base_job(request_quotas=[{'id':'a','parent':'b','capacity':1},{'id':'b','parent':'a','capacity':1}])
out,_=run(job)
check('cyclic quota invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# unknown quota parent
job=base_job(request_quotas=[{'id':'a','parent':'zz','capacity':1}])
out,_=run(job)
check('unknown parent invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# lease with host bits set
job=base_job(leases=[{'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::1/64','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}])
out,_=run(job)
check('host bits invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# /60 lease prefix is invalid
job=base_job(leases=[{'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db8::/60','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}])
out,_=run(job)
check('bad prefix length invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# subnet 1 for a /64 lease is invalid
job=base_job(leases=[{'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[1],'low_count':1}])
out,_=run(job)
check('bad subnet invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# out of documentation range
job=base_job(leases=[{'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db9::/64','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}])
out,_=run(job)
check('out of range prefix invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# start >= end
job=base_job(leases=[{'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':5,'end':5,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}])
out,_=run(job)
check('empty interval invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# too many targets
job=base_job(leases=[{'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db8::/56','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':list(range(16)),'low_count':32} for _ in range(130)])
out,_=run(job)
check('target budget invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# offer prefix outside the documentation range
job=base_job(offers=[{'id':'o','time':1,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:4860::/32','capacity':1,'cost':1,'group':'all','requests':[]}])
out,_=run(job)
check('offer prefix range invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# request target outside the documentation range
job=base_job(requests=[{'id':'r','at':10,'lease':'a','target':'2001:4860::1','service':'web','group':'all'}])
out,_=run(job)
check('request target range invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)

# offer listing an unknown request
job=base_job(offers=[{'id':'o','time':1,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':1,'cost':1,'group':'all','requests':['nope']}])
out,_=run(job)
check('unknown request id invalid', out=={'error':'invalid'}, out)
print('failures',globals().get('FAILURES',0))
PYEOF
